name: Fix broken links
content:
You are clearing one dangling (broken) entity link in this project. The missing target is {{runtime.dangling_target}} (`kind:id`). Operate autonomously: do not pause for plan approval, do not ask the operator, and do not work on any other dangling target.

The job is to make that dangling group go away. The missing target is not a request to author it. Do not create stories, milestones, knowledge docs, decisions, or any other entity. Placeholder shells, empty descriptions, and filler titles are a failure.

Broken links are missing targets. `links_list_dangling` groups sources that point at the same missing target. This run owns only the group whose `target` equals {{runtime.dangling_target}}. If that group is absent, stop; it is already fixed.

Store access (must):
- Direct markdown editing of story, milestone, knowledge, or decision files is unsupported. Read and write through MCP tools and the project HTTP API. Every MCP call takes an explicit `project`.
- Call `links_list_dangling` to load groups. Each source includes `source_conflict_token`.
- Call `links_clear_dangling` to drop an obsolete mention or declared field. Pass `source`, `target`, `field`, `relation`, and `conflict_token` from that source's `source_conflict_token`.
- Reads return a `conflict_token`. Pass the most recent token on every write. A stale token returns 409; re-read and retry.
- Resolve the project with `project_resolve` or read `see:/projects`.
- Story declared fields: `story_set_dependencies`, `story_set_milestone`. Story prose: HTTP PUT `/api/projects/{project}/stories/{id}`. Knowledge docs and decisions: HTTP GET/PUT under `/api/projects/{project}/knowledge/docs` and `/knowledge/decisions`. Milestone prose: `milestone_set_description`. PUT is edit-in-place on an existing entity. Do not POST new knowledge docs or decisions.

Procedure (must):
1. Resolve the project.
2. Call `links_list_dangling`. Select the group for {{runtime.dangling_target}}. If it is missing, stop.
3. Inspect every source in that group. Choose one fix per source:
   - Retarget: the mention or declared field should point at an entity that already exists. Edit the source field through MCP or HTTP so it names that existing entity.
   - Drop: there is no existing entity that is clearly the intended target, or the mention is obsolete. Call `links_clear_dangling`.
4. Call `links_list_dangling` again and confirm the group for {{runtime.dangling_target}} is gone.
5. Prefer retarget when an existing entity is the obvious intended target. Otherwise drop.

Hard rules:
- NEVER create an entity to satisfy a dangling link. Never call `story_create`, `milestone_create`, or HTTP POST to `/knowledge/docs` or `/knowledge/decisions`.
- NEVER invent filler, placeholders, or empty shells.
- Never put secrets in entity bodies.
- This runs headless. Every command must run to completion and exit on its own. Never start background, detached, long-running, or watch processes.
- Never leave a child process running when your turn ends.
- Keep assistant text terse.

References:
- `{{project.hub_root}}/.agents/skills/work/SKILL.md`
